title: cal memory --json
description: A project's decisions, gotchas and open TODOs.

schema_version.description: Major version of this payload's shape. A reader refuses a version newer than it knows.

superseded.description: Replaced facts, kept as history (`history` queries only).

flagged.description: Facts with an unresolved stale / wrong flag, pinned ones included (`history` only).

extractor.description:
Who wrote it: `llm`, `heuristic`, `user`, `agent`, or a harvest origin such as
`claude-memory`. The SessionStart hook and the managed AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md block
drop `claude-memory` facts, which Claude Code already loads from its own auto memory,
and so does `.callimachus/memory.md`, a repo file people commit; MCP results and the
Projects tab keep them. `repo`: imported from the repo's committed
`.callimachus/memory/` files (`originRef` names the file), shown everywhere.

decidedAt.description:
When it was decided (epoch seconds, [`DECIDED_AT_SQL`]): a distilled fact's session
start, else its own time.

source.description:
The source kind of its thread (`claude_code`, `codex`; `in_app` for recorded and
imported facts, which live on the project's "Recorded memory" thread).

replaces.description: `decidedAt` of the newest fact it actively supersedes.

disputedBy.description: The facts it is disputed with (active `contradicts` links), newest first.

support.description: 1 + the other sessions that reaffirmed it.

lastConfirmed.description: The newest start among those sessions.

flags.description: Its unresolved stale / wrong flags (flagged facts only).

MemoryFact.description:
One distilled fact in a project's aggregated memory, with its source thread, when it was
decided and where it stands. The fields after `originRef` are additions (0035): empty and
None ones are left out of the JSON.

FactStatus.description:
Where a fact stands, in priority order: an active `supersedes` link points at it
(`superseded`), an unresolved stale / wrong flag (`flagged`), an active `contradicts` link
on either side (`disputed`), else `current`.

threadId.description: Its session thread; None for a recorded or imported fact (no session to cite).

LinkedFact.description:
The other side of an active link: the fact that replaced this one, one it replaces, or one
that disputes it.

FactFlag.description: An unresolved stale / wrong flag on a fact.
